summary: Tested the removal of the chapter reviews (7 Reps only), backend and UI. Backend: the new test_lords_gym_seven_reps.py ran 12 tests and all passed. They covered: exactly 7 assessments (ids 1-7) with kinds initial/section/final and no chapter kind; ids 101 and 117 return 404; a free user gets the paywall on A2-A7 (402 on GET); paid and admin users have A1-A6 unlocked with A7 locked by sequence (403); the video keys are exactly 3 general keys plus section_2..6, with section URLs hidden for free users; admin video save ignores chapter_1; non-admin save returns 403; a section submitted out of order (A4 first) works; A7 unlocks after A1-A6 are done; master-results has only the rows/total/reviews keys (5 each); the scorecard PDF starts with %PDF. UI: Free dashboard has the 'Initial Spiritual Assessment' heading with only card 1, and A2-A7 each show a padlock and an Unlock button. The paywall modal lists 'Section review wrap-up videos' and does not mention chapters. /chapter/1 redirects to /. A1 submitted through the UI lands on /congrats/initial with Spread the Word and Join the Conversation; Join opens the paywall and Spread goes to /spread-the-word. /videos shows training-video-1..5 (locked for free, placeholders for paid, no 6th). Admin dashboard: A2-A6 show Start Rep, A7 shows Locked. Completing A2 in the UI gives a result page with section-video-block, the section-video placeholder and Spread the Word (href /spread-the-word), and no Join button. /admin/videos shows 8 rows (registration_thanks, initial_congrats, pastor_final, section_2..6) with no chapter rows; saving shows a toast and persists after reload. Paid user's /master-results shows the 5-row table, the Section Reviews list and no Chapter Reviews; the PDF downloads as Lords-Gym-Training-Scorecard.pdf. The A1 result page has no section video block.

issues: The 5 reviews sit in a 3-column grid, so the second row has an empty 6th cell that still has the surface background. It looks like a missing item. Consider sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5, or giving the last item col-span-2.
